summary: Modules about how your key sounds: they speak it aloud, so you hear it as well as read it.

steps.title: Reads your key's language
steps.text: From its spelling, words and script, and from the Context when a spelling fits more than one language.

steps.title: Speaks it as saved
steps.text: Your key exactly as the page holds it, in that language, by a natural voice.

steps.title: Fresh every time
steps.text: Each card and each Retry is spoken anew; a language the voice cannot speak is said so, not guessed.
